reasons: Both answers meet every rubric item. Each flags the retención problem and the SAS's liability, covers ICA closure in Medellín and RIT registration in Bogotá, handles the domicile amendment and the RUT update, hedges its percentages and recommends a contador. B adds useful items A misses: withholding on the El Poblado rent, the establecimiento de comercio, the fact that the NIT stays the same, cesantías deadlines around the move and the territorial ICA question for digital services. Its assumptions about the current year and month count (2025, March through December) are a minor weakness.
